correctness_rule: all gates conjunctive; no waivers; missing is failure for technical eligibility

complexity_measurement.hand_maintained_semantic_surfaces_per_te: maximum number of semantic artifacts or state surfaces an actor must intentionally edit or repair for one term change; generated atomic outputs count zero; any manual repair counts one
complexity_measurement.authoring_task_errors: count across the frozen eight-actor six-task paired cohort; timeout, invalid source, wrong fact delta, manual generated-surface repair, or reviewer-rejected result counts one
complexity_measurement.median_paired_task_seconds: median elapsed monotonic seconds across successful paired actor/task observations; timeout observations use the fixed timeout ceiling
complexity_measurement.new_production_semantic_loc: nonblank noncomment source lines in compiler/validator/authoring adapter required beyond the common fact-stream comparator; generated, test, fixture, and vendored lines excluded; count per frozen revision
complexity_measurement.custom_normative_contract_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of variant-specific schema/profile/protocol text not supplied by an external standard; fixture and test bytes excluded
complexity_measurement.added_direct_runtime_dependencies: count of locked direct non-stdlib production dependencies used by compiler/validator/authoring path

dominance: A Pareto-dominates B iff A is <= B on every complexity dimension and < B on at least one; correctness-ineligible variants are excluded before comparison

ergonomics_sufficient.missing_rule: any missing actor/task/variant observation or model substitution -> insufficient_evidence

disposition_table.condition: one eligible variant and ergonomics sufficient
multiple eligible variants; exactly one Pareto-undominated; ergonomics sufficient
multiple Pareto-undominated variants and V1 is among them
multiple Pareto-undominated variants and V1 is not among them

tie_semantics: Retaining V1 on an unresolved comparison is a rollback-safe operational disposition, not proof that Markdown is architecturally superior or permanent.
rfc_gate: Only winner:<variant> may support an architecture RFC. no_winner_* retains current production behavior and may support only a revised experiment or bounded hardening proposal.
